queries.result: English was used as the United Kingdom's official working language for these services. The Swindon first-party map portal and HM Land Registry first-party dataset/service pages were confirmed; no separate non-English cadastral service was identified.

sourceAssessment.name: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons, Swindon Borough Council
sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Swindon Borough Council is evidenced as the local map-portal operator/custodian; the reviewed portal does not establish a legal parcel-fabric endpoint.
sourceAssessment.serviceType: Official monthly local-authority GML download plus public INSPIRE WMS, indicative registered-freehold extents/positions, not a complete legal cadastre.
sourceAssessment.nativeIdField: INSPIREID (documented by HM Land Registry; feature payload not retrieved)

geometryVerification.exactWupPointTest: Not run against parcel geometry: WMS GetMap returned an image, but the advertised WMS layer is queryable=0; WMS GetFeatureInfo returned LayerNotQueryable, and WFS is explicitly disabled. The exact WUP point was not shifted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: HM Land Registry states INSPIRE Index Polygons show indicative positions/extents of registered freehold properties in England and Wales and are a subset of all index polygons.
coverageAssessment.limitations: The Swindon download landing page listed a Swindon Borough Council ZIP, but the anonymous download request returned a repeated HTTP 302 self-redirect and no payload. The public WMS GetCapabilities response exposed CP.CadastralParcel and CRS metadata; its layer was non-queryable, and WFS responded ServiceUnavailable/disabled. No feature count, schema payload, safe native ID, or parcel geometry was verified. These request/UI limitations are not evidence of citywide absence.
